moves.name:
Spring Breeze
Scale Shot
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s Attack is raised.
Deactivation Condition:
When the user’s Attack is not raised.

Never misses. Raises the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Attacks the target two to five times in a row. Raises one of the user’s following stats by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] at random when attacking at least three times in a row: Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy, or evasiveness. Applies the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] to the user when attacking at least four times in a row. Increases the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="3" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="4" ] [EN:Qty Ref="4" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when attacking five times in a row. If the remaining MP for the user’s [Name:MoveId Idx="18500" ] is [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] or more when attacking with this move, reduces those MP by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] and grants all of the following effects: Maximizes the number of attacks. Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ].
